name: Corran Analytical
blurb: A contract laboratory. What its sample table says is what its clients are told.
banner: Results are released to clients at 09:00 on the working day after sign-off.

content.text: Corran Analytical is accredited for water, soil and food testing. Accreditation is reviewed each April. The reviewer looks at twenty results chosen at random.
Meeting, 6 March. Item 1: the centrifuge. Item 2: who keeps moving the centrifuge. Item 3: Tomasz asked again about the Aldous Foods retests and was told again that it is a commercial matter.
Instrument 4, 2 March: run AF-0931, AF-0932, AF-0933. Operator T. Bryl. No faults. Readings saved to the register at 16:12.

RETEST REQUEST. Sample AF-0932, Aldous Foods, infant cereal, batch 7C.

First result, 2 March, instrument 4, operator T. Bryl: FAIL. Mould toxin at three times the limit.

Client telephoned 3 March. Retest requested 'on a fresh portion supplied by the client'. Retest, 4 March: pass.

Quality Manager's note: release the retest. The first result is to be treated as an instrument fault. No fault was logged.
